description: Antigravity Multi-Agent Orchestration Pipeline for Modern Interactive Landing Page

agents.name: Architect Agent
responsibilities: Define responsive UI/UX structure & layout hierarchy
Specify component tree (Hero, Feature/Roadmap, Media Area, Catalog)
Issue strict JSON schemas for components and data contracts

agents.name: Design System Agent
responsibilities: Enforce Dark Slate (#0F172A) background & Neon Pink (#FF0055) / Cyan (#00F0FF) palette
Implement Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur) and Metallic Border Gradients
Configure Tailwind CSS classes, keyframe animations, and responsive tokens

agents.name: Frontend Developer Agent
responsibilities: Implement production-grade React components with Lucide icons
Build interactive sound/video visualization player with Web Audio API
Handle state transitions, interactive hover effects, and modal controllers

agents.name: QA & Review Agent
responsibilities: Execute automated code linting (oxlint) and syntax checks
Verify responsive breakpoints (mobile, tablet, desktop) and WCAG contrast
Audit DOM accessibility, keyboard navigation, and harness data integrity
